argv:
import json, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
M = "docs/missions/20261018-2b-autonomy"
A, B, C, D = ("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
              "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444")
t = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
for name in ("receipts", "specs", "logs"):
    (t / name).mkdir()
def put(kind, rid, role, mission, provider):
    (t / kind / f"{rid}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"run_id": rid, "role": role, "mission": mission, "provider": provider, "work_unit": "plan"}))
put("receipts", A, "brain", M, "claude")
shutil.copy("tests/fixtures/observe/claude-subagent.jsonl", t / "logs" / f"{A}.log")
put("specs", B, "brain", M + "/", "claude")
put("receipts", C, "worker", M, "codex")
put("specs", D, "brain", "docs/missions/other", "claude")
(t / "specs" / "junk.json").write_text("{not json")
rows = [
    {"type": "architect-run", "plan": "T-1", "seat": "claude.brain-planning", "subagent_stats": {"spawned": 2}, "outcome": "done"},
    {"type": "architect-run", "run_id": A, "plan": "T-2", "seat": "claude.brain-planning", "subagent_stats": {"spawned": 2}, "outcome": "done"},
    {"type": "architect-run", "run_id": B, "plan": "T-3", "seat": "claude.brain-planning", "subagent_stats": {"spawned": 1}, "outcome": "done"},
    {"run_id": C, "task": "T-001", "seat": "codex.economy", "outcome": "done"},
    {"type": "architect-run", "run_id": A, "plan": "T-4", "seat": "claude.brain-planning", "subagent_stats": {"spawned": 1}, "outcome": "done"},
]
routing = t / "routing-data.jsonl"
before = [json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":")) for r in rows]
routing.write_text("".join(line + "\n" for line in before))
argv = [sys.executable, "scripts/subagent_audit.py", "--mission", M, "--tasks-dir", str(t), "--routing", str(routing)]
dry = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
assert dry.returncode == 0, dry.stderr
assert routing.read_text() == "".join(line + "\n" for line in before), "routing changed without --mark-manual"
out = subprocess.run(argv + ["--mark-manual"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert out.returncode == 0, out.stderr
assert out.stdout == dry.stdout
table = [[c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")] for line in out.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("| ")]
assert table[0] == ["run id", "work unit", "log present", "provider", "Task/Agent calls", "subagent tokens", "record"], table[0]
body = table[1:]
assert body == [
    [A, "plan", "yes", "claude", "2", "1234", "receipt"],
    [B, "plan", "no", "claude", "unknown", "unknown", "spec only"],
    ["none", "T-1", "no", "claude", "unknown", "unknown", "no run id recorded (ad hoc)"],
], body
assert C not in out.stdout and D not in out.stdout
assert "Unconfirmed routing rows: 3" in out.stdout.splitlines(), out.stdout
after = routing.read_text().splitlines()
assert len(after) == 5
assert after[1] == before[1] and after[3] == before[3], "a confirmed or unrelated row changed"
for index in (0, 2, 4):
    expect = dict(rows[index]); expect["source"] = "manual"
    assert after[index] == json.dumps(expect, separators=(",", ":")), after[index]
again = subprocess.run(argv + ["--mark-manual"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert again.returncode == 0 and routing.read_text().splitlines() == after, "second run changed the file"
routing.write_text(routing.read_text() + "{broken\n")
snapshot = routing.read_text()
bad = subprocess.run(argv + ["--mark-manual"], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert bad.returncode == 2 and bad.stdout == "" and bad.stderr.startswith("subagent_audit: "), (bad.returncode, bad.stderr)
assert routing.read_text() == snapshot
print("ok")
